summary: The Bank of New York Mellon Corp filed an 8-K announcing the redemption of all 5,825 shares of its Series H Noncumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock and the corresponding 582,500 depositary shares (each representing a 1/100th interest) on June 20, 2026. The redemption is at par plus accrued dividends, as per the terms of the preferred stock. The action is a mandatory redemption by the issuer, with no board recommendation or advisor named. The mechanics involve a straightforward cash redemption on the scheduled dividend date. What to watch: the redemption is fully anticipated and carries no transaction risk; the risk-arb angle is nil as it is a unilateral issuer action.
